mode.name: Master and Satellites
mode.description: Teams capture a master box and its satellites as in Domination. Only the master scores, and the satellites its holder also holds raise its points; when the master changes hands, every satellite goes back to neutral.
mode.description_pt: As equipas capturam uma caixa mestre e os seus satélites como no Domínio. Só a mestre pontua, e os satélites que a mesma equipa tiver aumentam os seus pontos; quando a mestre muda de mãos, todos os satélites voltam a ficar neutros.
mode.author: The Atalaia contributors
mode.description_de: Teams nehmen eine Master-Box und ihre Satelliten ein wie bei Domination. Nur der Master punktet, und die Satelliten, die sein Team auch hält, erhöhen seine Punkte; wechselt der Master den Besitz, werden alle Satelliten wieder frei.
mode.description_zh_tw: 各隊像佔點模式一樣佔領主站盒子與它的衛星。只有主站會得分，佔有主站的隊伍同時佔有的衛星會提高主站的分數；主站易手時，所有衛星都回到中立。

comment.text: Who holds this box, and since when (game time in seconds).

fields.NAME: capture_hold_ms
fields.LABEL: Hold time to capture (ms)
fields.LABEL_ZH_TW: 佔領需按住的時間（毫秒）

comment.text: A box the controller told it is the master shows its holder's satellites; others who holds them.
A new holder of the master starts with no satellites (they are freed); the controller's next status confirms it.
The GM's owner override, and the controller freeing the satellites: a team, or none to free the box (a free box stays as it is).
From field.lua, to the master box only: its holder's satellites and points per tick.
Who holds the master, and how many satellites they hold too (the console shows both).

fields.NAME: tick_s
fields.LABEL: Seconds per scoring tick while a team holds the master
fields.LABEL_PT: Segundos por intervalo enquanto uma equipa tem a mestre
fields.LABEL_DE: Sekunden pro Wertungsintervall, solange ein Team den Master hält
fields.LABEL_ZH_TW: 一隊佔有主站時的計分間隔（秒）

fields.NAME: points_per_tick
fields.LABEL: Points per tick for the master alone
fields.LABEL_PT: Pontos por intervalo só pela mestre
fields.LABEL_DE: Punkte pro Intervall für den Master allein
fields.LABEL_ZH_TW: 主站本身每次計分的分數

fields.NAME: satellite_bonus_pct
fields.LABEL: Bonus per satellite held, in % of the master's points (rounded down)
fields.LABEL_PT: Bónus por satélite, em % dos pontos da mestre (arredondado para baixo)
fields.LABEL_DE: Bonus pro gehaltenem Satelliten, in % der Master-Punkte (abgerundet)
fields.LABEL_ZH_TW: 每個佔有的衛星的加成，主站分數的 %（無條件捨去）

fields.NAME: min_satellites
fields.LABEL: Satellites the master's holder needs before the master scores
fields.LABEL_PT: Satélites de que a equipa da mestre precisa antes de a mestre pontuar
fields.LABEL_DE: Satelliten, die das Team des Masters braucht, bevor der Master punktet
fields.LABEL_ZH_TW: 主站開始計分前，佔有主站的隊伍需要的衛星數

comment.text: How many satellites a team holds.
The master's points per tick: the points alone plus a bonus per satellite, rounded down; none below the smallest number of satellites.
Box owners come from the boxes' reports, which can arrive a little after the capture event, so this also runs every second. When the master leaves a team's hands, every satellite is freed.
The first points come one full tick after the capture.

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 The Atalaia contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#
# A team holds a satellite (or a box with no controller). Data: team, since
# (game time of the capture, in seconds). Boxes do not score: the master does;
# lang (pt, en, de or zh-tw) from the box.
template: captured
layout:
  - type: row
    style: { width: fill, height: 44, background: team }
    children:
      - type: label
        text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'ZONA OCUPADA' || lang == 'de' && 'ZONE BESETZT' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '據點已佔領' || 'ZONE HELD'}"
        style: { font_size: 20, width: fill, align: center, color: contrast }
  - type: spacer
    height: fill
  - type: label
    text: "{team|upper}"
    style: { font_size: 48, color: team }
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'desde' || lang == 'de' && 'seit' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '佔領於' || 'held since'} {since|clock}"
    style: { font_size: 20, color: muted }
  - type: spacer
    height: fill
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'Mantém o botão premido para a tomar' || lang == 'de' && 'Halte den Knopf zum Übernehmen' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '按住你的按鈕即可奪取' || 'Hold your button to take it over'}"
    style:
      font_size: 14
      color: muted
      padding: { bottom: 10 }
screens.master_status:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 The Atalaia contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#
# A team holds the master. Data: team, since (game time of the capture, in
# seconds), held and of (the satellites the team holds, of all of them) and
# points (the master's points per tick with that bonus), from the controller;
# lang (pt, en, de or zh-tw) from the box.
template: master_status
layout:
  - type: row
    style: { width: fill, height: 44, background: team }
    children:
      - type: label
        text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'MASTER OCUPADO' || lang == 'de' && 'MASTER BESETZT' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '主站已佔領' || 'MASTER HELD'}"
        style: { font_size: 20, width: fill, align: center, color: contrast }
  - type: spacer
    height: fill
  - type: label
    text: "{team|upper}"
    style: { font_size: 48, color: team }
  - type: label
    text: "{held} {lang == 'pt' && 'de' || lang == 'de' && 'von' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '/' || 'of'} {of} {lang == 'pt' && 'satélites' || lang == 'de' && 'Satelliten' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '個衛星' || 'satellites'}"
    style: { font_size: 20 }
  - type: label
    text: "{points} {lang == 'pt' && 'pontos a cada' || lang == 'de' && 'Punkte alle' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '分，每' || 'points every'} {params.tick_s} s"
    style: { font_size: 20, color: "{points > 0 && 'white' || 'danger'}" }
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'desde' || lang == 'de' && 'seit' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '佔領於' || 'held since'} {since|clock}"
    style: { font_size: 14, color: muted }
  - type: spacer
    height: fill
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'Mantém o botão premido para a tomar' || lang == 'de' && 'Halte den Knopf zum Übernehmen' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '按住你的按鈕即可奪取' || 'Hold your button to take it over'}"
    style:
      font_size: 14
      color: muted
      padding: { bottom: 10 }
screens.neutral:
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 The Atalaia contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#
# Nobody holds the box (a master or a satellite) in a running game (decision
# BN-11). No data of the mode's; the hold time comes from the game's
# parameters, lang (pt, en, de or zh-tw) from the box.
template: neutral
layout:
  - type: row
    style: { width: fill, height: 44, background: panel }
    children:
      - type: label
        text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'ZONA' || lang == 'de' && 'ZONE' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '據點' || 'ZONE'}"
        style: { font_size: 20, width: fill, align: center }
  - type: spacer
    height: fill
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'LIVRE' || lang == 'de' && 'FREI' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '中立' || 'NEUTRAL'}"
    style: { font_size: 48 }
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'Mantém premido' || lang == 'de' && 'Gedrückt halten' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '按住按鈕' || 'Hold to capture'}"
    style: { font_size: 20, color: accent }
  - type: label
    text: "Hold your button for {params.capture_hold_ms / 1000} s"
    style: { font_size: 14, color: muted, visible: "{lang != 'pt' && lang != 'de' && lang != 'zh-tw'}" }
  - type: label
    text: "{params.capture_hold_ms / 1000} s para capturar a zona"
    style: { font_size: 14, color: muted, visible: "{lang == 'pt'}" }
  - type: label
    text: "{params.capture_hold_ms / 1000} s zum Einnehmen der Zone"
    style: { font_size: 14, color: muted, visible: "{lang == 'de'}" }
  - type: label
    text: "按住 {params.capture_hold_ms / 1000} 秒即可佔領據點"
    style: { font_size: 14, color: muted, visible: "{lang == 'zh-tw'}" }
  - type: spacer
    height: fill
  - type: label
    text: "{lang == 'pt' && 'Nenhuma equipa tem esta zona' || lang == 'de' && 'Kein Team hält diese Zone' || lang == 'zh-tw' && '目前沒有隊伍佔領此據點' || 'Nobody holds this zone'}"
    style:
      font_size: 14
      color: muted
      padding: { bottom: 10 }
